newsitem.title: POLAND: Farmfood seeks 10-15 pct market share.
newsitem.headline: Farmfood seeks 10-15 pct market share.

text.p: Polish food producer Farmfood SA wants to increase its share of the Polish market to between 10 and 15 percent by the year 2000 from the current three percent, Farmfood's president said on Tuesday.
"Our strategy provides for raising our market share to 10 to 15 percent," Wojciech Wtulich told a seminar on Poland's meat processing market.
Wtulich said Farmfood, which specialises in meat processing, planned to increase its output by making new acquisitions and modernising its existing factories.
